title: Active agent capability descriptor
description: Machine-readable manifest of the tools an agent may call against Active (CHECKLIST Step 0.006, PROPOSAL section 4.1 item 6). Versioned with the workspace; consumers must reject unknown major versions.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Parse a file and report errors, cycles, and unresolved names with stable diagnostic codes and spans. Zero exit means clean.

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Evaluate a file and print redacted JSON. Secrets always render as ***SECRET***; a raw secret in output is a defect, never data.

tools.name: format
tools.description: Format a file in the canonical style without changing its meaning.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an evaluated result to another format with redaction preserved.

tools.name: graph
tools.entry: active graph <file> [--format text|mermaid|dot|json]; active impact <KEY> <file>; active why <KEY> <file>
tools.description: Query the dependency graph: render it, list what breaks if a key changes, or list what a key is built from.

output.graph: text, Mermaid, DOT, or JSON per flags

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Emit typed artifacts from an Active schema for the listed codegen targets.

tools.name: schema-introspect
tools.description: List a schema's fields, types, constraints, defaults, descriptions, and deprecations as versioned JSON (INSPECT_VERSION=1).

input.file: path to a .active source file with a schema block

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Deterministic per-diagnostic repair guidance (stable text per code, value-free).

output.guidance: lines of CODE path span: guidance

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Minimal @rename/@patch directives for mechanical diagnostics (safe typos, strict-explicit fills); empty when nothing maps exactly.

tools.name: capability
tools.description: Print this descriptor; fail closed when the descriptor major does not equal N (handshake).
